mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the static permission-matrix gate lets the model invent a Permitted Operation whose (role, kind) cell is statically denied by the contract — e.g. a compliance officer permitted to GetRecord, which is exactly what LeastPrivilege and the compliance content-blindness predicates are supposed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_StaticMatrixViolation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Permitted and op.caller.role = ComplianceOfficer and op.kind = GetRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the conditional rules lets a clinician be permitted to read a record without any active care-team-membership row, which violates the care-team-gating and non-care-team-denial assertions.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BypassConditional { some op: Operation | op.caller.role = Clinician and op.kind = GetRecord and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = op.caller and m.rec = op.target and m.status = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the one-audit-per-operation constraint lets the model invent an Operation with no matching AuditEntry, breaking the always-on audit invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some op: Operation | (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.op = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the attribution fact lets the audit entry's recorded accessor / role / kind drift from the operation it claims to record, which is exactly the misattribution AttributionCorrectness forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadAttribution { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.accessor != ae.op.caller or ae.accessorRole != ae.op.caller.role or ae.opKind != ae.op.kind }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the note-to-op uniqueness lets two distinct Operations claim creation of the same ClinicalNote — the structural signature of a re-emission / mutation, which the AppendOnly assertion is intended to detect.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoteAppendViolation { some disj op1, op2: Operation | some n: ClinicalNote | (op1.createdNote = n and op2.createdNote = n) }
